name: ai.clearthesis/clearthesis
title: Clearthesis
description: Plain-English investment theses on 650+ US stocks, refreshed every quarter.

tools.name: search_stocks
tools.description: Find US stocks that Clearthesis has a full investment thesis on, by ticker or company name. Use this first to check whether a stock is covered.

query.description: Ticker or company name, for example "nvidia" or "COST"

tools.name: list_covered_stocks
tools.description: Returns every US stock Clearthesis has an investment thesis on, as ticker and company name.

tools.name: get_stock_thesis
tools.description: Plain-English investment thesis on a US stock: what the business does and how it makes money, financial performance, moat and competition, management, a 1-to-5 quality scorecard, and key numbers, with sources. Includes a link to the full thesis, where Clearthesis gives its fair value estimate, five-year projections and verdict.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol, for example NVDA or BRK-B

tools.name: get_stock_updates
tools.description: Recent events for a covered US stock (earnings, filings, analyst rating changes, material news), each explained in plain English with why it matters for a long-term owner and links to the primary source.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol, for example NVDA or BRK-B

limit.description: How many recent updates to return (default 8)
